paper_metadata.title: Scaling Autoregressive Models for Content-Rich Text-to-Image Generation
paper_metadata.abstract: We present the Pathways Autoregressive Text-to-Image (Parti) model, which generates high-fidelity photorealistic images and supports content-rich synthesis involving complex compositions and world knowledge. Parti treats text-to-image generation as a sequence-to-sequence modeling problem, akin to machine translation, with sequences of image tokens as the target outputs rather than text tokens in another language. This strategy can naturally tap into the rich body of prior work on large language models, which have seen continued advances in capabilities and performance through scaling data and model sizes. Our approach is simple: First, Parti uses a Transformer-based image tokenizer, ViT-VQGAN, to encode images as sequences of discrete tokens. Second, we achieve consistent quality improvements by scaling the encoder-decoder Transformer model up to 20B parameters, with a new state-of-the-art zero-shot FID score of 7.23 and finetuned FID score of 3.22 on MS-COCO. Our detailed analysis on Localized Narratives as well as PartiPrompts (P2), a new holistic benchmark of over 1600 English prompts, demonstrate the effectiveness of Parti across a wide variety of categories and difficulty aspects. We also explore and highlight limitations of our models in order to define and exemplify key areas of focus for further improvements. See https://parti.research.google/ for high-resolution images.

extraction_data.innovation: Autoregressive next-token prediction over a learned 8192-vocabulary image codebook for text-to-image generation; employs a CoCare ranking model to rerank 16 sampled images per prompt, demonstrating significant quality improvements when scaling model size.
extraction_data.pretraining_corpus: LAION-400M (incorporated during fine-tuning with classifier-free guidance), highly filtered dataset (pre-training)
extraction_data.finetuning_task: Supervised fine-tuning for text-to-image generation, Fine-tuning with classifier-free guidance
extraction_data.paper_title: Scaling Autoregressive Models for Content-Rich Text-to-Image Generation
extraction_data.finetuning_data: MS-COCO (2014), Localized Narratives (COCO subset), MS-COCO, Localized Narratives (LN-COCO)
extraction_data.hardware_description: 64-way data parallelism; 16-stage pipelines for encoder and decoder; circular schedule for decoder pipeline
extraction_data.training_pipeline: Next-token prediction loss over 8192-vocab image codebook, averaged over 1024 output tokens; 16 images sampled per prompt and reranked using CoCare ranking model
extraction_data.quantization_precision: bfloat16 for attention and feed-forward layers; float32 for layer norms and model output
extraction_data.safety_evaluation_protocol: Informal testing, bias analysis, prompt filtering, output filtering, model recalibration
extraction_data.optimizer_innovation: Quantized first moments of optimizer slot variables from float32 to int8
extraction_data.benchmark_result: MS-COCO FID: 350M: 14.10, 750M: 10.71, 3B: 8.10, 20B: 7.23; Human eval MS-COCO: 91.7% image realism, 90.5% image-text match; P2 benchmark: 20B preferred over retrieval baseline (63.2% realism, 75.9% match); MS-COCO FID: 7.23 (zero-shot), 3.22 (finetuned); LN-COCO FID: 15.97 (zero-shot), 8.29 (finetuned); Captioner BLEU: 26.4, METEOR: 23.9, CIDEr: 83.9, SPICE: 16.5; MS-COCO FID: 2.47 (Random), 17.97 (Retrieval), 9.33 (XMC-GAN)
